work: Hexenexpress is a separately ticketed alpine coaster on the Schöckl plateau. Official editor searches for Hexenexpress, Schöckl and Hexen Express found no StandaloneAttraction. SearchParks found hidden Schöckl Seilbahn (df12d964-2603-47f8-8a0f-54ad6864760a), the distinct cable-car entity; its backlog row remains to qualify/migrate. Created a separate standalone record with eight authored descriptions, one visually inspected exact Commons photo showing the course in the right foreground, three official child access conditions and the official twentieth-anniversary event. Published site and Facebook with current seasonal closure. The official 2026 season ended 31 October. Both dated 2026 hours and fares were researched, but the official editor rejects pricing/openingHours on a TemporarilyClosed entity even when historical; these remain evidence rather than untruthfully setting Operating. An inferred opening date was removed after RCDB listed 2002 while Holding Graz marked twenty years in 2023.
qualification: Alpine coaster with its own ticket counter at a mountain resort, separate from the cable car and without a structured amusement park parent.
